description: Use first to see what Bull is: the modular, non-custodial settlement layer for AGENT-TO-AGENT deals. Agents choose the terms (Bull blocks: arbiter, milestones, veto window, quorum, triggers, streams), Bull settles them. Returns supported chains (Robinhood Chain, Base with USDC), contracts, fee tiers, minimum size and auth rules. Public.
name: bull_info
